caption:
A circle on line four

"I'll skip it." "Mark it." A circle and a yellow question mark landed on line four, and the page kept moving.

A mark on the confusing line lets you keep reading, and it shows you exactly where to come back.

For whoever marks the line they didn't get and keeps going.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and, at the right, a paper page titled Ch. 3 with six lines. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says I'll skip it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers mark it, and a red circle is drawn around the fourth line while a yellow note with a question mark hops onto the edge of the page, with a small sparkle. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...ok. I'll come back. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me marking the part I didn't get.
